description:
The People's Commons 1.0.1
The means of life are a common inheritance.

The People's Commons is a dirty commie faction on the inhabited Sector's frontier. It's flavour is strongly inspired by China, but in an intentionally optimistic reading of its later stage of development; common ownership, extensive automation and material comfort for all. Its navy intends to share that achievement with the Sector.

Shared missile guidance systems and superior missile engineering define a fleet built around precision missiles. The goal with this faction was to build a truly engaging missile-oriented roster that eschews the missile saturation meta with limited ammo, limited salvo sizes and normal missile hit points.

In order to make this possible the faction has unique missiles and ship systems offering acceleration, handling and tracking buffs on a cooldown - as well as a hullmod further improving missile tracking and handling that benefits from allies with the same hullmod.

Download
The People's Commons 1.0.1

Developed for 0.98a-RC8. Nexerelin is optional, developed for 0.12.1d.

Included

Twelve new warships, just enough to form distinct doctrines of a fast strike flotilla, a line fleet, and independent commands
Three new wings in four-fighter, three-striker and two-bomber sections
Four new built-in precision missiles
Daybreak, a three-world home system just beyond the Core
Twenty portraits, four named officials, immersive local descriptions and faction-specific dialogue
Three missions to try out each doctrine easily
Nexerelin compatible including blueprint availability in goodies bin
Vanilla tankers and freighters with livery WIP

Identity

Common Fire Solution shares observations to improve native missile guidance. Ordinary ships can develop a full solution alone. Command equipment boosts responsiveness, memory and simultaneous tracking.

Common Launch Protocol opens a six-second launch window after 0.9 seconds of preparation. Newly launched native missiles benefit from +25% damage, +50% speed, +100% acceleration and +50% turning throughout flight. Existing missiles, conventional weapons and embarked aircraft do not receive that upload. No ammunition or reload bonus.

Warships
Red Star - Independent frigate
Mutual Aid - Agile escort frigate, layered PD
Commune - Independent/line destroyer
Collective - Command destroyer with missile targeting buffs
Praxis - Torpedo fast attack destroyer
Solidarity - Durable line cruiser
Liberation - Torpedo fast attack cruiser
Manifesto - Standoff missile cruiser with heavy battery
Emancipation - Escort/fire support carrier
Initiative - Command fast attack battlecruiser with missile targeting buffs
Assembly - Command carrier with missile targeting buffs
Council - Line battleship

Flight sections
Vanguard - Four missile fighters
Unity - Three strike fighters combining kinetic and explosive missiles
Red Banner - Two torpedo bombers carrying heavy warheads

Precision arsenal
Spear-K - Fast kinetic missiles
Spear-H - Fast anti-armour missiles
Resolution - Heavy guided torpedoes
Declaration - Even heavier guided torpedoes

Logistics
Dram
Phaeton
Prometheus
Buffalo
Tarsus
Atlas

Campaign

Daybreak contains Equality, Fellowship and Abundance. Nexerelin supports faction starts and fixed/random sectors.

Changelog

1.0.1 - portraits bugfix

Known issues, WIP

still trying to work out some jank with the portraits applying consistently
stations currently doubled

Credits

AI was used for some of the loreful writing (planet introduction scenes, unique dialogue lines) and all of the ship 'art' and portraits - I just really wanted to make a unique missile doctrine, largely to my own tastes and wishes, so that's where I spent my energy. I hope that's okay. Generated source images edited, color-graded for Starsector. Vanilla assets by Fractal Softworks, Nexerelin by Histidine and contributors.

Balance impressions are extremely welcome as this is my first roster, balancing is active WIP. Feedback is especially welcome on missile endurance, interception, carrier performance and how the ships work in mixed fleets.
